OpenRPC document meta-schema extracted without modification from =@open-rpc/meta-schema= version 1.14.9, =index.js= export =openrpcDocument=, which supports OpenRPC 1.3.2. Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/@open-rpc/meta-schema/1.14.9; license in =LICENSE.openrpc.md=. Validation resolves its external JSON Schema reference locally; builds and checks do not fetch schemas.

The referenced JSON Schema tools meta-schema is vendored from https://github.com/json-schema-tools/meta-schema/blob/3f340ae906f45278f62d16fc68741cd0c2d33eaf/src/schema.json with its upstream license. Both slash and non-slash URI forms resolve locally.
